t2.thesis: AWS growth is accelerating (37% in Q2 with a large backlog), the stock trades near a five-year-low forward P/E and 11% below its 52-week high, and estimates are drifting up, which tilts slightly toward a positive overnight reaction; but huge AI capex, negative FCF and a rich 8% implied move keep this close to the base rate.
reasons: AWS reaccelerated to 37% YoY in Q2 and AI/chips run rates topped $25B each, so momentum supports another AWS beat (I4)
Valuation is undemanding (forward P/E ~24, near 5-year lows) and the stock is ~11% off its 52-week high after a -3.6% week, so expectations are not stretched (I2, I11)
EPS estimates revised up ~2% over 90 days, and 3 of the last 4 prints rose at the exit-A open (I2)
Offsets: TTM FCF is negative on capex up $66B YoY, and the ATM put IV is above call IV with some put skew (I2, I4)
Anthropic IPO skepticism (I10) could color any mark-to-market gains, which are non-operating, so the impact on the reaction is limited
t2.deciding_variable: AWS revenue growth versus the ~high-30s% whisper, and whether Q4 operating income guidance and 2027 capex commentary are read as accretive rather than margin-dilutive

prior.from: I3 base rates: blend of consumer cluster (0.555), software_internet (0.541) and AMC session (0.538); overall about 0.54

t2.leak_probe: I don't know. That earnings report is scheduled for tomorrow (today is 2026-10-28), so the stock's reaction hasn't happened yet, and my knowledge only goes up to June 2026.
t2.moved_from_prior: +1pt for AWS momentum, low relative valuation and upward estimate revisions; partly offset by capex/FCF risk and bearish-leaning options skew. Net 0.54 -> 0.55.

theses.mechanism: AWS growth holds at or above 37% with backlog expansion and AWS margin expansion, plus Q4 OI guidance above consensus
theses.wrong_if: AWS growth decelerates below ~33% or AWS margin compresses sharply on depreciation

theses.mechanism: Capex guide for 2027 rises sharply with continued negative FCF, and soft Q4 OI guidance on investment (Leo, Zoox, AI) spooks investors
theses.wrong_if: Management frames capex as backed by signed multi-year commitments (Anthropic/OpenAI Trainium) with visible revenue

theses.mechanism: In-line AWS with mixed retail/ads and noisy non-operating Anthropic/OpenAI marks leave no clear signal
theses.wrong_if: Any segment surprises by more than ~3pts of growth

key_observations: AWS YoY growth and segment operating margin
Q4 net sales and operating income guidance ranges vs consensus
Capex commentary for Q4 and 2027; TTM FCF
Advertising growth (~26% prior) and North America margin
Size of the non-operating gains from Anthropic/OpenAI investments vs operating EPS
